SASBDB entry SASDTW4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDTW4/)

24-mer (PDB 3bve), 20 mM Tris pH 8.0
Publication DOI: 10.1016/j.bbrc.2023.149276
The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder. The paper was consulted only for SASDRR8
(Europe PMC); the others were unreachable, so their buffer, temperature and wavelength are
the SASBDB entry's (see the header of test/fitting_tests/SASDTW4/SASDTW4_fit1.jl).

Files: SASDTW4_fit1_model1.pdb (SASBDB's model, unmodified), SASDTW4_fit1.fit (depositor fit),
experimental_data/SASDTW4.dat. Reference: CRYSOL 1.343 (header Chi^2 1.343 = chi2).
Conditions: 20 °C, 0.15406 nm (SASBDB).
Model: 34358 heavy atoms + 4 waters (dropped); sample construct differs from 3bve.
